home.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished, high-resolution desktop WEBSITE HOMEPAGE design concept for the existing Chinese outdoor travel companion Meri. Landscape 16:10 composition, straight-on full webpage, no laptop frame, no presentation board or annotations. Reference image 1 is the EXISTING BEAR IDENTITY: orange brown bear with cream muzzle, green hiking hat with mountain badge, green jacket, brown backpack and hiking boots, folded map. Translate this exact recognizable bear into a charming restrained low-poly wooden collectible 3D character, not a different mascot. Reference image 2 is the existing website landscape art direction: pale paper sky, watercolor/pixel alpine lake and peach sunlight. Preserve that distinctive blue lake / sage pines / paper background palette rather than a generic SaaS redesign.
Layout is an evolved version of the current homepage: warm pale paper upper 65%, large quiet negative space, centered small mountain brand mark and pixel-inspired 'Meri' wordmark, a crisp readable Chinese headline '你想去哪里？'. Under headline, a clean wide rounded input panel, restrained border and tiny shadow, exact placeholder '跟 Meri 说说你的旅行想法…', dark forest-green arrow send button. Below input show two unobtrusive example texts '周末去山里走走' and '还没想好去哪'. Upper right compact '我的旅程' and '中 / EN'. Lower-middle a section '继续探索', with two modest horizontal travel cards with DIFFERENT believable photographic scenery and short titles '云南徒步' and '青岛周末'; they are secondary and don't dominate.
Bottom 35% is gorgeous cinematic lake / forest / mountain landscape, reflecting an eventual subtly looping background VIDEO represented by a beautiful still frame: faint fog across water, sunlight on distant peaks, atmospheric depth, no literal video player controls. At lower right, integrate a tactile 3D mini campsite diorama of the same bear reading a map at a tiny timber desk, a muted sage tent, backpack, warm lantern, stylized low-poly trees and a small landscape base, realistic soft ambient contact shadows. Bear is a small delightful focal point, not giant. Tiny subtle text beside this area '进入营地' indicates optional 3D interaction. This is a concept ONLY, no claim video/3D already works. Blend wooden 3D character with painterly environment deliberately, crisp clean actual UI text, editorial craft but approachable product, light theme, consistent forest-green ink and rounded corners. Strong readable hierarchy; center input remains obvious. Avoid purple gradients, glass everywhere, gauges, dashboards, navigation clutter, share/PDF/export buttons, itinerary results, weather claims, marketing feature sections. Don't invent additional text.

workspace.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished high-resolution desktop WORKSPACE webpage design concept for Meri Chinese outdoor travel companion, landscape 16:10, straight-on actual interface, no device frame, no presentation board, no annotations. Reference image 1 is its newly designed homepage: match this site's sage-green ink, cream paper, blue/peach alpine scenery, pixel mountain brand, and especially tactile wooden low-poly orange bear in green hiking hat and jacket with brown backpack. Reference image 2 is the original bear identity, preserve the face and outfit. We are designing a separate functional workspace from this brand, not another homepage.
Composition: restrained blue mountain-lake scenery just visible around a generous cream paper application surface, occupying about 90% of canvas, rounded outer 20px edge. Compact top masthead brand 'Meri', link '回到首页', right status '已保存' and menu icon. Beneath, workspace title '云南徒步' with a small believable photographic snowy mountain thumbnail, muted single metadata row '上海出发 · 11月8日—11月12日 · 公共交通'. This is hypothetical UI example data not a generated itinerary. Crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, strong readable labels, clear whitespace, moderate density, genuine functioning product visual design.
Two column layout: LEFT roughly 62% main conversation, RIGHT 38% journey state and visual companion.
LEFT: understated section '和 Meri 一起探索'. Show user chat '想去云南走走，看看雪山。' as small sage aligned-right bubble. Assistant reply '可以先看看这两个地方，选中后会加入你的旅程。' with tiny bear avatar. Below it TWO compact destination choice cards in one row using REALISTIC PHOTOGRAPHIC travel images, NOT watercolor illustrations: snowy mountain / lake for '丽江', highland town / landscape for '香格里拉', short captions '雪山与古城' and '高原与山谷', clear unchecked square selectors, one button beneath '添加所选'. Photos represent where actual Amap photography belongs; do not imply the mock image fetched live provider photos. Keep destination choices unselected; they must not already appear saved in right overview. Lower left a quiet disabled button 'Generate plan' with helper '规划功能尚未开放', bottom wide conversation composer with exact placeholder '告诉 Meri 你的想法…' and forest-green arrow send button. No invented itinerary or successful plan.
RIGHT upper: simple '旅程概览' with compact editable rows '出发地  上海', '目的地  云南省', '时间  11月8日—11月12日', '交通  公共交通', fine understated edit icons. Only province selected, no silently selected city. Beneath overview, modest light wireframe globe with two small photographic tiles circling it to suggest existing destination-photo presentation, keep this element small and secondary; label '目的地印象' so imagery reads as provincial impressions.
RIGHT lower: a gorgeous 3D interactive 'Meri 的营地' preview window, larger than globe but subordinate to chat, pale sage surface with very restrained border. It contains a tactile tabletop diorama: same orange bear seated reading map at wooden desk, compact green tent, warm lantern, backpack, low-poly pine trees, stone/grass base; same wooden collectible finish and identity as reference homepage. Gentle ambient lighting, realistic contact shadows and depth, no photorealistic furry bear. Small top-right expand button and understated bottom hint '拖动看看 · 点击进入营地'. It should unmistakably feel like a Web3D canvas embedded INSIDE the product, not a decorative sticker floating over form fields. Show the bear full enough to inspect, avoid clipping. No big separate central 3D scene.
Light theme throughout, paper and sage rounded UI, shared brand with homepage but clear task workspace. No share buttons, PDF/export, weather forecasts, booking buttons, fake itinerary results, maps implying verified routes, purple gradients, excessive glass panels, or ornamental statistics. Readable genuine Chinese, use only quoted strings plus tiny necessary labels, no gibberish.
